description: This file defines types, data structures, and utility functions for inter-process communication (IPC) in the Playwright testing framework, including configuration, test lifecycle events, and payload serialization.

methods.name: serializeConfig
methods.description: Serializes the full configuration object into a structured format suitable for IPC, optionally including the compilation cache and metadata.

methods.name: stdioChunkToParams
methods.description: Converts a chunk of data (Uint8Array or string) into a TestOutputPayload, encoding buffers as base64 strings.
